name: vdr-automation
description: FedRAMP 20x Vulnerability Detection and Response (VDR) reporting. Imports Nessus, Tenable, Qualys, and Wiz scanner exports into a findings workbook, manages the finding lifecycle, generates FedRAMP 20x VDR reports with live CISA KEV and EPSS enrichment, and produces per-release Product Vulnerability Disclosure Reports. Wraps networkbm/POAM-Automation-Tool.
